en: Vintage sepia postcard with an ornate Art Nouveau border, featuring two main images of a baroque pilgrimage church. The left image shows a richly decorated interior altar with columns, statues, and garlands. The right image shows the church with twin towers on a wooded hill above surrounding buildings. There is cursive handwriting around the margins. Printed German text identifies the location and printer.
